releaseName: Styled Version Card + Tablet Version Sync
message: Verdant 15.4.9 replaces the tiny floating Main Board version text with a matching HUD status card and keeps the iPad version on the same build.
notes: Copies the nearby PLAYERS card styling when available.
Shows VERSION and 15.4.9 in a compact two-line Verdant card.
Keeps the card at the existing version label position instead of changing the board layout.
Updates the iPad/tablet version label to Version 15.4.9 in the same installer pass.
Retains the 15.4.8 supporter ownership and anti-revert work.
